description: Keeps only 'keep' grains from the start of each consecutive set of 'out_of' grains and CLOSES THE GAPS - the omitted grains are removed, not silenced, so the sound gets shorter (verified: keep 1 of 2 on a 10-grain 2.0 s train -> 0.9927 s; keep 3 of 4 -> 1.6 s; keep 2 of 2 -> 2.0 s exact pass-through). A thinning sieve for grainy material: the kept grains are always the FIRST keep of each set. Duration model indur*keep/out_of is the smooth baseline; the real output is (kept grain count) x (grain spacing), which quantises per set - exact when out_of divides the grain count, up to ~+19% longer than predicted otherwise (keep 1 of 4 on 10 grains keeps ceil coverage: 0.5928 s vs 0.5 predicted). Grain detection is the standard family gate (default 0.3, byte-verified; banner's 'default 1' wrong). keep is breakpoint-capable through time (banner-confirmed 'Keep may vary over time'); out_of is not. Deterministic; mono and stereo accepted.
musical_use: Rhythmic decimation that keeps the groove's front edge: because the survivors are the first grains of each set, a keep/out_of of 1/2 halves a pulse stream into onbeats, 1/4 quarters it, 3/4 drops every fourth event - and since gaps close up, the result is a FASTER, denser phrase rather than a gapped one (contrast grain grev mode 4, which replaces units with silence and keeps the timing). Breakpointing keep against a fixed out_of thins the texture progressively - a 1->3 ramp over a 4-set turns sparse into nearly-full across the file (verified: brk render 1.0 s, between the 0.59 s and 1.6 s scalar extremes). On a single-grain sound (e.g. a sustained tone above the gate) it passes the file through unchanged - keep 1 of 2 on a pure tone returned 2.0 s intact.

keep.description: Number of grains kept from the start of each set (CDP-enforced 'Parameter[1] Value (0.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 63.000000)'). Breakpoint-CAPABLE (banner: 'Keep may vary over time, but must not exceed out_of'; verified: a 1->3 brk at out_of 4 renders 1.0000 s, differing from both the keep=1 (0.5928 s) and keep=3 (1.6000 s) scalar renders). keep > out_of is an INVALID DATA refusal: 'A value of 3 grains-to-keep out of each 2 is impossible.'

out_of.description: Size of each grain set (CDP-enforced 'Parameter[2] Value (0.000000) out of range (2.000000 to 64.000000)'). Breakpoint refused: 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 2 [oo.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'

len.description: Maximum time between grains in seconds (family-standard: CDP-enforced 0.1 to the input duration; manual's minimum '1' is wrong). Breakpoint refused (family-standard).

gate.description: Required signal level for a grain to be seen (CDP-enforced 0-1). Real default 0.3 (verified: unflagged render byte-identical to -l0.3 on an alternating loud/soft train). Breakpoint-CAPABLE (verified: a 0.05->0.5 gate ramp render differs from both the gate-0.05 and gate-0.5 scalar renders).

minhole.description: Minimum duration of inter-grain holes (CDP-enforced 0.032 - the default - to the input duration, family-standard). Breakpoint refused (family-standard).

winsize.description: Envelope-tracking window in ms for a signal-tracking gate; 0 = off (CDP-enforced 0 to the input duration in ms, family-standard). Breakpoint refused (family-standard).

ignore_last.description: Ignore the last grain in the source. Must follow the value flags (CDP flag-order enforcement, family-wide).

examples.description: Halve a pulse stream: keep the first of every pair of grains.
examples.expected_use: Every other grain survives, gaps close - output about half the input duration, tempo feels doubled.

examples.description: Progressive thinning: keep rises 1 to 3 out of every 4 across the file.
examples.expected_use: Sparse opening filling toward nearly-complete (write keep_ramp.brk with breakpoint(): 0.0 1 / end 3).

known_issues: Duration honesty: the model indur*keep/out_of is a smooth baseline for a per-set quantised process. Exact at keep 1 of 2 on an even 10-grain train (-0.7%); +19% at keep 1 of 4 on the same train (0.5928 s actual vs 0.5 predicted: partial final sets still contribute their kept grains). Error shrinks as grain count grows; plan with slack on short/sparse material.
Omitted grains are REMOVED (time closes up), not silenced - for silence-preserving omission use grain grev mode 4.

Acceptance-with-truncation landmine (generalization matrix): material that dips below the gate mid-texture is segmented into pseudo-grains and thinned - flat noise with edge ramps returned 1.9101 s from 2.0 s at keep 1 of 2 instead of refusing. Sounds with a single detected grain pass through unchanged (pure tone verified, 2.0000 s intact; no refusal).

keep > out_of refused at runtime: 'ERROR: INVALID DATA / ERROR: A value of 3 grains-to-keep out of each 2 is impossible.' A keep BREAKPOINT that exceeds out_of anywhere is the same refusal - keep the envelope's ceiling below out_of.
DIVERGENCE: banner gate 'default 1' vs real default 0.3 (byte-verified); manual len minimum '1' vs enforced 0.1 (family-wide).
Deterministic (runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical). Stereo accepted (verified 2-channel out, same thinning).
-x must follow the value flags (family-wide flag-order enforcement).
